name: PageHeader
description: The top of a page: breadcrumbs, a title with badges, a description, actions on the right and tabs underneath. Every part is optional except the title.

title.description: The page's title, shown as an h1 by default.

headingLevel.description: Heading level of the title, 1 to 6. Keep 1 unless the header sits inside another page.

description.description: One or two sentences under the title.

breadcrumbs.description: A Breadcrumbs component, shown above the title.

meta.description: Badges or a status shown next to the title.

actions.description: Buttons for the right of the title. They wrap under the title on a narrow screen.

tabs.description: A Tabs list (or any navigation) shown under the title.

isLoading.description: Show the title and description as skeletons and mark the header busy.

size.description: compact for pages with little room, such as a side panel or a dense admin screen.

border.description: Draw a line under the header.

classNames.description: Extra class names for single parts, so you can restyle one part without editing the file. Keys: root, breadcrumbs, title, meta, description, actions, tabs.

keyboard: Tab: moves through the breadcrumbs, the actions, then the tabs
requirements: The title is a real heading (h1 unless you change headingLevel), so there is one clear heading to jump to
Breadcrumbs keep their own navigation landmark; the header adds none
While loading the header is marked busy and the title keeps a hidden "Loading" text, never a made-up title
On a narrow screen the actions move under the title instead of squeezing it

use_when: The top of any page or detail screen
Inside DashboardPage, which uses it for its heading
avoid_when: Headings for a section inside a page: use SectionHeader
anti_patterns: More than one h1 on a page
Putting the main action in tabs instead of actions

contract.data: A title, and optional description, breadcrumbs, badges, actions and tabs.
customization: breadcrumbs, meta, actions and tabs slots
